'''Nicki''' was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] who was part of the tribe when the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Endor strike team/Legends|strike team]] landed on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] to destroy the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. He was present in the village when [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] told the story of the story of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|struggle]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Royal Hut]]. He later celebrated the Alliance's victory at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="VI" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nicki was portrayed by [[Nicholas Read]], credited as Nicki Reade, in {{Film|VI}}. This [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] appears twice in ''Return of the Jedi'': he jumps in front of [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa's]] hut when [[C-3PO/Legends|Threepio]] is telling the tale and later does a cartwheel and dances with [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]] during the celebration.<ref name="SWI 67">[[Star Wars Insider 67|''Star Wars Insider'' 67]]</ref>

Nicki seems to have made his way into ''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]'', appearing when the village prepares the caravan's journey.
